npc: ^Calypso: Wow! Another successful harvest today! Thanks, Luna!
^Luna: Don't sweat it, Calypso. Helping you out is always more fun anyways.
^Luna: Nah... it's a long story. Trivial, really.
^Calypso: You know I love listening to your stories! And I'm not going anywhere.
^Luna: Well... not much of a story, but recently I've been reminded of my best friend...
^Luna: Or at least... I still think we are.
^Luna: But lately, it just feels as if we've been living completely different lives...
^Luna: Back then, I wouldn't have believed things would end up like this. I thought she'd be a friend for life, joined at the hip...
^Luna: But now... it's like we're strangers to each other.
^Calypso: I'll always be here for you.
^Calypso: No worries! Uncle's Chariot is coming down. Hey, why don't you go out and get some fresh air?
